name: Setmore
description: Setmore is a free online appointment scheduling platform that helps businesses automate bookings with a customizable booking page, payments, and reminders.
best_for: Salons, medical practices, fitness centers, and other service businesses wanting a free, easy-to-set-up booking system.
features: Internal staff calendar with instant sync to the public booking page
Payment collection via Stripe, Square, and PayPal
Zoom and Google Meet integration for virtual appointments
Two-way calendar sync with Google Calendar and Office 365

alternatives.name: Calendly
alternatives.description: A scheduling tool that lets people share availability links to book meetings without back-and-forth emails.
alternatives.best_for: Individuals and teams booking one-off or recurring meetings

alternatives.name: Acuity Scheduling
alternatives.description: An online appointment booking platform with branded booking pages, payments, and reminders.

alternatives.name: Doodle
alternatives.description: A group scheduling tool that lets people poll participants to find the best meeting time.
alternatives.best_for: Groups coordinating a meeting time across many participants
